name: Lynne K. Davis
residence: Cheyenne, Laramie County (her campaign site describes her as a local mixed-media artist whose work is featured in Cheyenne)
occupation: Retired; her campaign website says that before retiring in 2013 she designed user interfaces for a national science digital library, and that she later worked as a local mixed-media artist (davis4wyoming.com, About me)
background: Lynne K. Davis was a Democratic nominee for Laramie County commissioner in 2026 and lost the November 3 general election. On the About page of her campaign website she wrote that she is a Pennsylvania native, that her path took her from New Mexico to Colorado and then to Wyoming, that before retiring in 2013 she spent her professional career designing user interfaces for a national science digital library, and that she has served on the board of a makerspace, taught metalsmithing and lapidary arts, and works as a local mixed-media artist whose work is featured in Cheyenne. She won the Democratic primary and finished behind the three Republican nominees in the general election.
